semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Great Domain Enterprise operates as an agency in the semiconductor field, providing services and products related to semiconductor and IC assembly, but does not appear to manufacture semiconductor components directly.
summary: Great Domain Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a professional agency established in 1981, specializing in various fields including semiconductor and IC assembly, photoelectronics, and nano-technology. The company has introduced numerous leading technologies and products to the Taiwan and China markets, supported by multiple branch offices to serve its customers effectively.
capabilities: Agency services for semiconductor and IC assembly
Distribution of materials and parts for photoelectronics

regional_presence.Taiwan: Great Domain has branch offices in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Kaohsiung to support local customers.
regional_presence.China: The company operates a Shanghai branch (Whole-Link International Co. Ltd.) to cater to the Chinese market.
